title: Surgery clerkship
audience: a medical student in the clinical years preparing for the USMLE
prerequisites: M1, S4, M12; helpful: S1, S8.
purpose: Manage surgical patients: preoperative assessment, fluids and nutrition, the acute abdomen, appendicitis and obstruction, hepatobiliary disease, hernias, trauma, burns and wounds, breast, thyroid and surgical oncology, vascular surgery, complications and perioperative care.

weeks.2: Fluids, electrolytes and nutrition in surgery

blocks.deliverable: Assess perioperative risk for a supplied patient.
Build a differential for abdominal pain by location.
Week 7 midterm; run the ABCDE survey and estimate a burn area.
Work up postoperative fever by timing.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Surgical case plan: for three supplied presentations, write the differential, the workup, the indication for surgery and the postoperative orders.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
